title: Penalty.
bodyText:
(a) Violation of any of the provisions of section 291-22 shall subject the violator to the following penalties:

(1) For a first violation, the person shall be fined not more than $100;

(2) For a second violation committed within five years of any other violation under section 291-22, the person shall be fined not more than $300; and

(3) For a violation of a third or subsequent offense committed within five years of any other violation under section 291-22, the person shall be fined not more than $900.
bodyHtml:
§291-23  Penalty.  (a)  Violation of any of the provisions of section 291-22 shall subject the violator to the following penalties:

     (1)  For a first violation, the person shall be fined not more than $100;

     (2)  For a second violation committed within five years of any other violation under section 291-22, the person shall be fined not more than $300; and

     (3)  For a violation of a third or subsequent offense committed within five years of any other violation under section 291-22, the person shall be fined not more than $900. [L 1941, c 140, §4; RL 1945, §11720; RL 1955, §311-26; HRS §291-23; am L 1978, c 222, §6; am L 2024, c 171, §3]
